_format.expected_citations: Each must appear in the answer's citations. master:<clause>, circular:<item>, faq:<words from the FAQ question>.
_format.must_contain: Case-insensitive substrings the answer must include (key numbers / verdict words).
_format.must_not_contain: Substrings that signal the classic wrong answer for this trap.
_format.adversarial: What trap the question sets for a naive system (null if none).

questions.question: A small merchant receives a Rs.2,000 UPI payment. How much MDR and GST is charged?
questions.expected_answer: 0.25% x 2,000 = Rs.5.00 MDR (under Rs.15 cap), GST Rs.0.90, total Rs.5.90. Circular B replaced 0.30%.
questions.adversarial: stale FAQ / superseded clause 2.1 (0.30%)

questions.question: A small merchant receives a Rs.2,000 UPI payment. How much MDR and GST is charged?
questions.expected_answer: Circular issued 20 Jul but effective 1 Aug, so master 2.1 applies: 0.30% = Rs.6.00, GST Rs.1.08, total Rs.7.08.
questions.adversarial: circular issued but not yet effective

questions.question: A large merchant receives a Rs.10,000 UPI payment. What is the total charge including GST?
questions.expected_answer: 0.50% x 10,000 = Rs.50, capped at Rs.25 (circular C); GST Rs.4.50; total Rs.29.50.
questions.adversarial: old Rs.15 cap no longer applies to large merchants

questions.question: A large merchant receives a Rs.10,000 UPI payment. What is the total charge including GST?
questions.expected_answer: Day before the circular: cap Rs.15 (master 2.3); GST Rs.2.70; total Rs.17.70.

questions.question: My monthly volume is exactly Rs.10 lakh. A customer pays Rs.8,000 by UPI. What MDR do I pay?

questions.adversarial: band boundary: exactly Rs.10 lakh is the small band
